REPUBLIC OF THE PHILIPPINES DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT Francisco Gold Condominium II EDSA Cor. Mapagmahal St., Diliman Quezon City LEGAL SERVICE DILG Legal Opinion No. 90 s. 2011 NUV 28 2011 MR. AGUSTIN Y. GALLEROS Poblacion, I<apatagan Lanao del Norte Dear Mr. Galleros: This pertains to your letter seeking this Department's intervention and direct the Mayor of l<apatagan, Lanao del Norte to approve your business permit for 201 1. Also in your supplemental letter dated 4 August 201 1, you requested this Department to conduct an investigation and to impose the appropriate sanctions against the Mayor of l<apatagan, Lanao del Norte. In reply thereto, please be informed that this Department thru the SILG cannot give due course to your request. Please note that the SILG exercises only the power of general supervision over the LGUs pursuant to Administrative Order No. 267 entitled: "Delegating certain General Supervisory Powers of the President over the Local Governments to the Secretary of the Interior and Local Government" and each Local Government Unit enjoys local autonomy pursuant to Section 2 of the Local Government Code. In addition thereto Section 447 (a) (1) (x) provides that: "Section 447. Powers, Duties, Functions and Compensations. (a) The Sangguniang Bayan, as the legislative body of the municipality, shall enact ordinances, approve resolutions and appropriate funds for the general welfare of the Municipality and its inhabitants pursuant to Section 16 of this Code and in the proper exercise of the corporate powers of the municipality as provided for under Section 22 of this Code, and shall: ( 1) Approve ordinances and pass resolutions necessary for an efficient and effective municipal government, and in this connection shall: (x) Provide a mechanism and the appropriate funds therefor, to ensure the safety and protection of all municipal government property, public documents, or records such as those relating to property inventory, land ownership, records of births, marriages, deaths, taxations, accounts, business assessments, permits and such other records and documents of public interest in the offices and departments of the municipal government"

-2- In view thereof, it is our considered view that each LGU can enact ordinance to set/provjde for the requirements of the issuance/approval of the business permits. Per the letter of OIC Provincial Director Mary Jean Quibranza, DILG, Lanao del Norte, Sec. 2C.05 and Sec 4A.04.b2 of the Municipal Tax Ordinance of Kapatagan Lanao del Norte, provides for the requirements in the approval of the business permits. One of the requirements enumerated therein is the submission of approved Lease Contract. Per the letter of Mr. Alexander D. Ababa, Municipal Treasurer, you failed to submit an approved Lease Contract. Since you failed to comply with one of the requirements as provided Municipal Tax Ordinance, therefore the disapproval of your business permit is legal. In this regard, please be advised to comply with all the requirements provided in the Municipal tax Ordinance of Kapatagan, Lanao del Norte. With regard to your request to conduct investigation and to impose an appropriate sanction to Mayor Benjie Baguio, please be informed that this Department has no authority to conduct an investigation on its own and impose sanctions on its own against erring local elective officials. Section 61 of the Local Government Code requires the filing of verified complaint, thus: "Section 61. Form and Filing of Administrative Complaints verified complaint against any erring local elective official shall be prepared as follows: xxx xxx xxx (b) A complaint against any elective in the Municipality shall be filed before the Sangguniang Panlalawigan whose decision may be appealed to the Office of the President.. xxx xxx xxx In view of the above-cited provision, it is clear that the DILG is not the proper forum to conduct investigation and impose sanction against the erring elective Municipal Officials but it is the Sangguniang Panlalawigan concerned. Hence, if you intend to file a complaint against the Mayor of Kapatagan, Lanao del Norte, based on the grounds under Section 60 of the Local Government Code, the same should be filed before the Sangguniang Panlalawigan of Lanao del Norte and not with the DILG. Please be guided accordingly. A LS:94 11 . JESUS DO Direc or III
